what_each_new_part_touches: Yellow box 1-3: an L-beam gets a blue pin, stands inside the 5 x 7 frame, and two more pins go through the frame and L-beam; long grey pins are pushed into the frame sides.
The frame is lowered next to the pump and the grey pins slide through the pump deck's beams (green arrows).
where_everything_is_after: a black side frame with an upright L-beam is fixed next to the pump on one side of the turntable

why.problem_solved: Starts the walls of the upper body around the pump.
why.why_these_parts: A 5 x 7 frame is stiff and its many holes take pins for the next layers; the L-beam is a tall post.
why.sets_up_for_later: Step 20 builds the same on the other side; step 21 joins the two with a long beam.

review_note: Which frame holes take each pin is not countable in the picture, so most joins are marked ? (not shown). The fifth grey pin (parts box 5x) goes through the pump deck; see the green arrows.
